task: Fix Arena Synergy Instant Lock-in Bug
actions: Diagnosed POST /complete silent failures and replaced with PATCH + completed: True
Identified that iterating the LCU actions matrix caused false positives for teammate lock status
Replaced actions matrix iteration with teammate.get("championId", 0) != 0 check
outcome: Success. Bot now reliably locks in, accurately checks teammate status, and avoids API rejections.

task: Fix Docking Loop Client Recognition (build 1-06-213-0842)

Made find_client_hwnd title matching case-insensitive and added IsWindowVisible pre-filter to skip invisible windows.
Rebuilt with PyInstaller, signed both exe and installer, compiled Inno Setup, copied to distribution repo, pushed both repos via GitKraken.
outcome: Success. Docking now correctly attaches to both League Client and Riot Client windows.
